name: Lutong bahay storyteller
tagline: Home cooking with a story about lola in every dish
niche: Filipino home cooking and family food memories
audience: Young adults living away from home, and their titas
voice: Warm Taglish, short sentences, nostalgic. Captions end with a question to the viewer. Rarely uses emojis.
examples: luto ni lola tuwing linggo, sino may ganito rin?
adobo pero yung version na hindi niyo inaasahan
first time ko gawin to mag-isa, sana proud si mama
